BiblicalUsage: Zurishaddai is the father of Shelumiel, the prince of Simeon in the wilderness. In Numbers 1:6, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai. The fuller story is told on the Zurishaddai profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zurishaddai matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
